description: Late-game signal that column 5 (second from the right) is full. It almost never fires unless column 5 is full. Given that, it gets stronger when few columns are left (strongest with one or two playable columns), when an open column is nearly empty, and when the player to move is losing by force. It is weak when column 5 still has room, even in a lost endgame.
effect: Suppresses column 5. Forced high where column 5 is still legal, it removes column 5's probability (-0.25 to -0.42) and spreads it over the other columns. Zeroing it in firing positions changes nothing because column 5 is already illegal there.
notes: Col5-full is necessary: activation jumps the move col5 fills (e.g. 0.9 -> 27.9) and stays near 0 otherwise. The rest is graded. Within a game the activation alternates by ply and is high on the forced-loss side (shallow solver in the program, depth 10). It also rises with fewer legal columns. Dev F1: p1 (col5 full and ply>=30) 0.37; p2 (col5 full and <=2 legal) 0.48; p3 (col5 full and lost) 0.45; p4 0.53; p5 (chosen, points rule) 0.525, P 0.39, R 0.80, AUROC 0.88, sim share 1.56. Most false positives sit just under threshold (10-19), so the boundary is fuzzy. Some winning positions still fire (pos 4039: 36). Synthesis best 41.9, below the dev max of 43.5.
